t_advice_summary_textbox.text: 2 variatons of gnome colours, they respond to either a red basket or yellow basket, the 2 baskets have either 0-4 mushrooms plus multiplyer or 5-9 plus the multipyer as the number of mushrooms increases it will then be time to switch gnomes it takes a while to work out but once i can see the pattern it should be fairly obvious when to switch colur corrosponding to which basket colour

vb_textbox.text: there are 2 baskets a red one that you will get to if you choose the brown, pink, red, purple gnomes and a yellow basket which the blue, green ,yellow gnomes go to. there is always a multiplyer automatically chosem which comes with all the colour gnomes, the highest points means you chose well so keep with that gnome untill the amount of mushrooms drop then switch over baskets,
